p16_preregistration_checklist.source_quote_p16: Freeze the market universe, exclusions, receipt-time information set, fee regime, order timing, sizing, fill model, stopping rules and evaluation metrics before the test. Limit candidate variants; log every attempted variant. Separate discovery, tuning and untouched evaluation periods. Sampling more prints from the same event does not solve small-sample uncertainty.
p16_preregistration_checklist.applicability_note: v1.2 template marks the checklist REQUIRED for cards 01-04; ATP-RJ is not a card 01-04 study — included per Conductor new-lab requirement (all new freezes). Statuses are Variants' pre-outcome declaration; Examiner gate_status stays null.
